preparation.rootProblem: The pipeline accepted architecture and synthetic-test progress as finished while the manual editor/upload flow still failed for the reviewer.
doNotRepeat: Do not mark architecture readiness as UX completion.
Do not use localhost-only synthetic paste/drop tests as proof of real browser clipboard or OS drag behavior.
Do not patch the legacy attachment-card upload button as the primary editor ingestion path.
Do not ship hover-only code-block controls that users cannot discover.
Do not return direct-upload URLs that are unreachable from the actual browser origin.
preparation.firstImplementationPriority: Close the real browser upload boundary from the exact manual-review origin: intent -> OPTIONS/PUT direct upload -> confirm -> signed download -> save/reopen.

noSuccessWithout: recorded manual-review origin and reachable public base host
browser-observed intent, direct PUT, confirm, signed download, save, refresh, and reopen
visible code-block language/copy/wrap controls with feedback
real clipboard paste and OS file drag checklist results
forbiddenCompletionClaims: unit tests passed, therefore paste/drop works
mock intent returned 200, therefore upload works
controls exist in source code, therefore users can find them

manualReview.reason: Task 20i automated phases were green, but the human/product decision changed: the custom Jixia code block chrome and Insert block dependency are rejected, and the local upload fixture remains wrong for server-first remote-browser review.
rootCauses: The task state claimed readiness despite missing reviewer-origin manual evidence.
The PRD optimized for visible custom code-block language/copy/wrap controls, but the accepted UX direction is BlockNote default codeBlock and slash/default insertion.
The upload review stack still mixed same-machine localhost assumptions with server-first remote browser requirements.
